fixes.description: Removed hardcoded default admin password and embedded standalone digest; added one-time first-run administrator setup flow and NEMOFY_ADMIN_PASSWORD env override.
Gated POST /api/auth/logout backend secret clearing and token revocation behind an authenticated same-origin session check.
Added outbound URL/DNS/IP validation blocking private/loopback/link-local/metadata addresses, disabled redirects, and blocked sending stored vault keys to non-canonical provider origins.
Resolved workspace paths using realpathSync across every path segment and symlink check, rejecting any symlink escaping workspace/.
Made thread persistence atomic (temp file + rename) and replaced stale post-await thread overwrites with reload-modify-save updateThreads().
Wrapped decodeURIComponent in parseCookieHeader with try/catch so malformed percent-encoded cookies never trigger HTTP 500.
Added per-session jti claims and persisted revokedTokens registry so logged-out session tokens are invalidated immediately on the server.
Moved Primary model configuration validation ahead of thread creation and user message persistence in /api/chat/send and /api/chat/jobs/start.
Restricted default CORS_ALLOW_ORIGINS to localhost:3000 with credentials disabled for wildcards, and stripped host filesystem paths from unauthenticated GET /health.
Fixed find_safe_compaction_split to walk backward to the initiating AIMessage when trailing parallel ToolMessages extend to the end of messages.
Added outbound URL/IP validation, canonical-origin enforcement for server-side provider API keys, and disabled automatic redirects in list_provider_models and probe_model_connectivity.
Refactored act_node to execute one unanswered tool call per checkpointed superstep with an act->act conditional edge until all tool calls finish, preventing re-execution on HITL resume.
Replaced default-SAFE bash_exec regex denylist with a fail-closed read-only command allowlist so mutating, redirected, subshell, interpreter, and network commands require HITL approval.
Added DNS IP validation blocking private/loopback/link-local/metadata targets in _validate_web_url and manual hop-by-hop redirect validation in fetch_webpage_markdown.
Added fail-closed ALLOW_UNSAFE_LOCAL_BASH guard for unisolated auto fallback and hardened local_isolated boundary checks against traversal, host paths, sensitive app files, and symlinks.
Added http(s)-only and private/loopback/metadata IP/DNS URL validation on both Express MCP config persistence and Python MCPServerConfig/load_mcp_tools_from_configs.
Compiled worker_graph with a shared MemorySaver checkpointer keyed by deterministic sub_thread_id and per-tool stepping so HITL resume continues at the paused tool call.
Added exclusive createOnly (wx) mode to workspace file creation returning HTTP 409 on conflict so New file never silently truncates existing files.
Checked HTTP response status in deleteSkillDocument, wrapped skill and MCP mutation handlers in try/catch, and styled error feedback in error red.
Rejected protocol-relative // external URLs in parseInlineMarkdown and hardened MarkdownMessage external-link detection.
